annotations.title: What a HCPCS billing code is

description: What a HCPCS Level II code on a bill, supplier invoice or explanation of benefits describes (a letter and four digits, e.g. E0601, J9271, A4253), with its Medicare coverage status, from CMS's quarterly HCPCS file. CPT codes (five digits) are not covered: their descriptions are copyrighted.
